proposedContributions.contracts: Extend the accepted Pages contentKind union with canvas. Define strict versioned Canvas DTO: stable node IDs, finite spatial bounds, typed connector endpoints referring to existing node IDs, canonical linked entity/attachment refs and source-revision occurrence IDs. Keep validation and domain ports renderer-safe, no service I/O. SaveCanvas requires the RoxCommand v2 envelope expectedRevision/idempotencyKey and body document/canvas/schemaVersion. LinkCanvasNode modifies this same aggregate under CAS; ExportCanvas reads an authorized canonical revision, not a second canvas store.
proposedContributions.commands: Register canvas.save in accepted command gateway. Validate principal/workspace, document contentKind, schema and all linked refs before commit; recheck policy/fence at transactional write. Duplicate identical actor/workspace/idempotency key returns persisted receipt; changed hash rejects before mutation. Existing aggregate requires CAS revision, with explicit REVISION_CONFLICT retaining original draft. LinkCanvasNode and export use the same policy/results and canonical IDs; exact secondary transport names must be accepted by root since record specifies only the primary transport.
proposedContributions.repository: Within foundation transaction perform scoped CAS update of canvas_document, append document_revision, update typed links/attachment relationships, persist command receipt and document.content_materialized outbox event together. Increment revision exactly once; zero CAS rows cannot produce success. Use shared command_receipt/outbox/inbox/entity/alias tables and existing WP-10 document_revision, not local duplicates. Materialization consumers enforce event dedup, aggregate/policy/tombstone fences and projection watermark. Preserve node geometry/connectors in canonical JSON across reload/export.
proposedContributions.migration: Add canvas_document with workspace/entity composite FK, positive schema version, nonnegative revision, JSON validation consistent with domain DTO, retained timestamps and workspace/entity lookup. Extend existing document_revision compatibly. Reference foundation command/inbox uniqueness, canonical node link target/type indexes and WP-39 attachment refs. Quarantine ambiguous legacy aliases. Before cutover preserve snapshot/writer route; after accepted shared writes use forward repair or verified reverse replay without deleting recent writes.
proposedContributions.tests: Use bun:test conventions already present in pages/storage.test.ts. New normative wp-43.test.ts must cover actual shared command/API behavior, two-client conflict preserving both drafts, malformed graph and schema rejection, geometry/connectors reload, target ACL search, attachment revoke, duplicate/reordered events, command crash-after-commit retry, legacy shared-write rejection and sensitive seeded overwrite mutation. Keep live renderer/reload scenario as additional evidence, not simulated fixture proof.
